title: Kissed Crispy Australian Prawns Skewers
description: Rich and crispy Australian dish featuring unwaxed lime and yuzu-cure, perfect for a festive occasion, this low-carb friendly recipe is a delight to taste buds.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together almond flour, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Add the prawns to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the almond flour mixture.
Thread the coated prawns onto skewers, leaving a small space between each prawn.
Brush the skewers with coconut oil and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 8 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
While the prawns are baking, mix together lime juice and yuzu juice in a small bowl.
After the prawns have baked for 8 minutes, brush the lime and yuzu juice mixture onto the prawns.
Return the skewers to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes, or until the prawns are cooked through.
